sections.theory:
Start of the game

The referee will start the game through a jump ball from the central circle. At the time of the jump ball the remaining players will remain outside the circle.

Point

When the ball thrown by some player enters the basket from above and comes down through the net, and during this no foul has been committed, then a point will be given. On basketing the ball from inside the three-point area 2, while on basketing the ball from outside the circle 3 points, and on a free throw one point will be given.

Necessary equipment for the match

Stopwatch, score sheet, score board, time-out clock, a card for signalling 5 fouls, a card for signalling 7 fouls.

Dead ball

When there is a point or some breach of law has occurred.

When the whistle blows at the time of a live ball.

When the ball is held (held).

When half the time or the extra time ends.

When there is the signal of 24 seconds.

Live ball

When the ball reaches its height at the time of the jump ball.

When the umpire gives the ball to the player for the free throw.

When the ball of the throw-in touches a player inside the court.
